nodes.name: Read Search Criteria from Baserow
nodes.notes: Reads all rows from Job Hunt Tracker > Search Criteria. The Build LinkedIn URL node skips rows whose Active field is false.

nodes.name: Build LinkedIn URL
nodes.notes: Builds the LinkedIn URL for an active Search Criteria row. Inactive rows are filtered by the preceding IF node.

nodes.name: Update Generated URL in Baserow
nodes.notes: Updates the Generated URL field on the matching Baserow row in Search Criteria.

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const value = $json.Active; if (typeof value === "boolean") return value; if (typeof value === "number") return value === 1; const scalar = value && typeof value === "object" ? (value.value ?? value.name ?? value.id) : value; return ["true","1","yes","active","enabled"].includes(String(scalar ?? "").trim().toLowerCase()); })() }}
